name: decide_permission_request
title: Decide a delegated permission request
description: Answer a member's permission request a team message handed to you as its decider (a tool call with its exact input; read it completely). Your duty instructions say what to allow, deny or escalate. Only the decider, before the deadline: late answers are refused and never mean permission.

decision.description: escalate hands it to a person; always for anything not plainly routine or plainly out.

reason.description: Short, without secrets: the owner and the member see it.
